N-add02#1.zh: 我们在路上遭到山贼袭击，有人受伤！不知能否借宿一夜！
N-add02#1.t: We were attacked by bandits on the road and one of us is hurt! Could you put us up for the night?

N-add02#4.zh: 你是谁！为何要偷袭我们？！
N-add02#4.t: Who are you? Why attack us from behind?!

N-add02#6.t: Brother Wang, you're wounded. Stand back and leave this one to me!
